title: MP Biomedicals magGENic Plant DNA Kit: Nucleic Acid Purification
author: Opentrons
materials: MP Biomedicals magGENic Plant DNA Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify sample capacity
steps.instruction: Note that the protocol can process up to 24 samples using the MP Biomedicals magGENic Plant DNA Kit.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the provided fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload your custom labware JSON files to the OT App via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware, selecting the .json files as required.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py extension) to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App, following the calibration tips.
